text:
celeste: Need a fresh battlecard row + 2 defensible bench hooks for next week's webinar. Opponents: cloud-managed endpoints, single-tenant LLM APIs, and self-host infra. Keep SDR language tiny.

omar: Agree. SDRs want 8-12 word opens and a 1-line comeback to 'we're on vendor X'.

rhea: Draft opens: "Want to stop surprise inference bills? 10min." "Need SLA-backed p99 without ripping models out?" "Curious how serving cuts per-token spend?"

noah: Bench hooks (unique wording): cost-first = "Observed ~29% unit-cost drop on batch pipelines by shifting to continuous batching + quantized payloads (8k sample)"; latency-first = "Tail-smoothing: p99 reduced from ~1.15s to ~370ms via routing+prefix cache (5k sample)". Add tiny method notes.

celeste: Good. Make the battlecard micro-claims: 1) Serving-first economics: optimize runtime not just instance size; 2) Tail-aware SLAs: measured, demoable p99s; 3) Low-friction adoption: layers on existing models.

omar: For the "we use cloud X" reply: "Sizing up is a blunt lever — we lower unit cost and attack tails without migration." Short and sharp.

rhea: Webinar hook idea: open with a 2-sentence customer micro-story (orders spiked, costs blew out), show two visuals (cost smoothing + p99 waterfall), then live tail-tracer demo. CTA = 1-line: "Book a 15-min tail review for your workload."

noah: Add a field script for reps for each bench hook. Cost script: "Show reserved vs continuous-batch run for 30 days, highlight predictable spend and CI on quality." Latency script: "Run a live 60s tail trace and point to fallback policy keeping availability."

playtest-bot: upload: https://drive.redwood/bench/1765439999/traces_sample.csv (auto)

omar: Also want two A/B subject lines for the invite: A) "Stop surprise inference bills — 15min demo" B) "See a live p99 tail-tracer — 15min". Keep <60 chars.

celeste: Rhea, Noah 14 please drop the two bench narratives + one-line methodology in /marketing/bench-briefs by EOD. Omar 14 assemble the slide with two panels (cost delta, p99 before/after). I'll compile the SDR one-liners and objections.

rhea: Dropping cost narrative now: https://drive.redwood/bench/1765439999/cost_narrative.md

noah: Dropping latency narrative in 30m. Method note included (sample sizes, synthetic peak windows).

omar: Slide ETA tomorrow morning. Method note for analytics: group by routing policy and normalize by token.

celeste: Playtest plan: 6 reps, 8-min session on Friday AM. We'll record top 3 opens and the one rebuttal that falls flat.

playtest-bot: reminder: Playtest scheduled Fri 09:30am PT (calendar invite sent).

noah: One more tiny ask: pick a single numeric claim to bake into the battlecard (e.g., "~30% token cost reduction") and attach sample size + CI. That makes it defensible in field Qs.

celeste: Lock claim to "~29% token cost reduction on batch generators (8k-sample, 95% CI)" unless anyone objects.

omar: Fine by me. rhea?

rhea: OK. I'll include the CI line.

celeste: Great. Final timeline: drafts by EOD, slide set by Tue AM, playtest Fri, finalize card next Monday. Thanks team. :sparkles:
